chunks.title: Modern Refrigerator Inverter Boards (2024+)
chunks.content: Modern PEL Refrigerators use Wanbao and Embraco FMX boards. Models 6350/6450/21850/22250 use Wanbao VATZ72L (WB-51.16.18 board). Models 2000/2200/2350/2550 use Wanbao VATZ60 (WB-51.16.16 board). Model 6360 alternate batch uses Embraco FMXA9CE (519306719 board). Models 6360/6460/21860/21960/22260 use Wanbao VETZ110L (WB-52.16.11 board).

chunks.title: Wanbao Board LED Flash Codes
chunks.content:
For Wanbao WB-51.16.18 (VATZ72L): 1 Flash = Over-current; 2 Flashes = Phase loss; 3 = Under-voltage; 4 = IC hardware over-current; 5 = Startup failed/locked rotor; 6 = Runaway over-speed; 7 = Over-voltage; 8 = Over-power.
For Wanbao WB-52.16.11 & WB-51.16.16: 3 Flashes = Over-power; 4 = Start failure; 5 = Locked rotor; 6 = Under-voltage; 7 = Over-voltage; 8 = Runtime over-current; 9 = Phase disconnect; 10 = HW over-current; 11 = Over-temp; 12 = ADC failure; 13 = Startup instant over-current.

chunks.title: Embraco Board LED Flash Codes
chunks.content: For Embraco FMXA9CE / VES 2456 DJF 00: 1 Flash (15s cycle) = Normal; 2 Flashes (5s cycle) = Comms signal lost; 3 Flashes (5s cycle) = Inverter control component breakdown; 4 Flashes (5s cycle) = Compressor hardware fault; 1 Flash (0.5s cycle) = High-temp shutdown.

chunks.title: AC NTC Sensor Resistances (25°C)
chunks.content: Ambient Air Sensor = 19.3 KΩ ± 5%. Indoor Evaporator Coil Sensor = 24.9 KΩ ± 5%. Outdoor Condenser Coil Sensor = 25.1 KΩ ± 5%. Compressor Discharge Head Sensor = 62.7 KΩ ± 5%. (NTC curve: resistance decreases as temperature rises).

chunks.title: AC Diagnostic Flowcharts
chunks.content:
Flowchart 2 (Inverter Compressor Ignition Failure): Check compressor phase resistances (U-V, V-W, W-U). If open/shorted, replace compressor. Else, verify DC output from IPM to motor; if erratic, replace outdoor PCB.
Flowchart 4 (Serial Comms Link Broken / Dead Outdoor): Verify L-L, N-N, S-S wiring. Test main protection fuse on outdoor board. Check bridge rectifier (~220V AC in, ~310V DC out). Measure optocoupler bias voltages (PC1/PC2).

chunks.title: AC Installation & Vacuum SOP
chunks.content: Refrigerant pipe extension: Factory pre-charged for 3 meters. Compensation factors: 12K AC (20 g/m), 18K AC (20 g/m), 24K AC (50 g/m). Max routing distance is 20m, max vertical lift is 10m. Deep Vacuum Procedure: Run vacuum pump on low-side gas service port for at least 15 mins until gauge reads 29.92 in.Hg. Close manifold valve, hold for 5 mins to confirm no pressure rise (leak/moisture check). Backseat high-side valve to release gas.

chunks.title: Microwave Error Codes
chunks.content: E01: Cabin temp exceeds safe limits (Super High Temp). Action: Press Stop/Cancel, verify sensor resistance. E02: Ambient temp drops below tolerance (Super Low Temp). Action: Cycle input power line. E03: Thermal processing circuit grounding short. Action: Replace thermal NTC/PTC component block. Cooling Fan Rule: Runs 3 mins post-cycle if task > 2 mins.

chunks.title: Fully Automatic Washing Machine Fault Codes
chunks.content: E0: Internal computing error (disconnect plug for 60s). E1: Water supply timeout (20 min without target - clean mesh filter). E2: Drainage timeout (7 min - check check-valve/debris). E3: Door/lid safety interlock opened during spin. E4: Imbalance detected during spin (redistribute load). E5: Flooding safety override (auto-drains). E6: Water-level sensor signal tracking failure (check wiring). E7: Child lock violation.

chunks.title: LED TV Diagnostic Flowcharts
chunks.content: Dead Chassis: Check 220V AC input. Measure ceramic input fuse. Measure filtered DC rail at main filter capacitor (needs ~310V DC). Check secondary 5V logic rail. Video Distortion (Vertical Lines): Clean LVDS ribbon pins. Measure VGL/VGH/VCOM at T-CON. If flat/shorted, replace T-CON; else internal panel cracked. Audio Loss: Measure voice coil resistance (4.0-8.0 Ohms nominal). If ∞ Ohms, replace speaker.
